    static long[] invFact;

        OutputStream outputStream = System.out;

        int m = in.nextInt();

            a = a * a % MOD;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

        return invFact[x] * fact[x - 1] % MOD;
    }

    static long ncr(int n, int r) {
        if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
        return fact[n] * invFact[r] % MOD * invFact[n - r] % MOD;
    }

    static long multiply(long... vals) {

    }
